title: Extra-dimensional radial gravity from fresh four-annulus MaNGA kinematics
hypothesis: A positive screened brane-to-bulk Green-function crossover with one universal compactification or localization scale predicts the held-out four-annulus Halpha circular-speed profile from baryons beyond strong ordinary radial controls and transfers unchanged to stellar rotation.

discovery_policy.universal_gravity_track: Require one unchanged extra-dimensional kernel and universal parameters to beat baryonic, structural, flexible, and ordinary radial controls across four Halpha annuli, transfer without kernel reselection to stellar circular motion, retain a positive Green function, recover the screened four-dimensional local limit, and remain eligible for later lensing and relativistic completion.
discovery_policy.phenomenon_publication_track: Retain a reproducible response-blind relation between continuum geometry or radial source structure and resolved rotation-curve shape beyond ordinary radial controls even if it is not evidence for an extra dimension.

theory_sources.boundary: ADD compact dimensions produce a Kaluza-Klein tower and a short-distance transition to a faster-than-inverse-square force; a galaxy-scale screened projection is a known-family combination, not the original ADD prediction.
Randall-Sundrum localization can recover four-dimensional gravity on a 3-brane despite a continuous KK spectrum; the bounded radial kernel here is only an effective Green-function projection.
DGP recovers four-dimensional gravity at short distances and crosses toward five-dimensional behavior at large distance; enhancement signs and baryonic screening variants are not automatically DGP.

Scale-dependent spectral dimension is known in quantum-gravity models; tying a bounded infrared relocalization kernel to response-blind baryonic structure is a potentially new synthesis, not proof of microscopic dimensional flow.

Torsion-balance data test the inverse-square law from 52 micrometers to 3 millimeters; galaxy-scale candidates require an explicit localization or screening proxy and cannot be presented as unscreened large compact dimensions.

Brane-world/Weyl-fluid rotation-curve fits are known prior art and commonly fit baryonic and bulk parameters per galaxy; Item 36 forbids per-object bulk or crossover parameters and uses held-out universal selection.

independence.rule: Reconstruct the Item 35 response-blind disk pool, then exclude every Item 35 exploration or confirmation role and every additional neighbor within 60 arcseconds before new mass-size cells, roles, folds, MAPS downloads, source thresholds, or velocity access.

sample.stratification: median response-blind stellar mass crossed with median response-blind half-light radius after all predecessor and coordinate vetoes; 45 selected per cell with ten sealed confirmations and seven exploration objects per fold per cell

derived_predictors.enclosed_mass: Sersic enclosed stellar-mass proxy using regularized gammainc(2n,b_n*(r/Re)^(1/n)) with b_n fixed by gammaincinv(2n,0.5)
derived_predictors.baryonic_speed: sqrt(G*M_enclosed/r) using the response-blind stellar-mass proxy; no gas, halo, velocity, or lensing mass is inserted
derived_predictors.orbital_frequency: baryonic_speed/r converted from km/s/kpc to Gyr^-1
derived_predictors.radial_source_slope: response-blind finite difference of log enclosed stellar mass across the four frozen annuli
derived_predictors.localization_coordinate: bounded combination of continuum nonaxisymmetry, radial source slope, surface density, and acceleration fixed before velocities

response.circular_amplitude: absolute c1 deprojected by the frozen photometric inclination

physics.action_proxy: S=(1/(8*pi*G5))*integral d4x dy sqrt(-g5)[w(y,Z_b)|grad_4 Phi|^2+|partial_y Phi|^2]+integral d4x rho_b Phi(x,y=0), reduced to a positive brane Green-function spectral kernel
physics.variation_proxy: The static brane propagator gives a_b multiplied by a bounded positive spectral response mu_extra(r,a_b,Z_b); circular delta log10(v)=0.5*log10(mu_extra).
physics.four_dimensional_limit: High-acceleration localization drives mu_extra to one at one AU; this is an explicit screening/localization proxy and is not claimed to be present in unscreened ADD, RS, or DGP.
physics.conservation_proxy: A positive static Green-function spectral density and source-independent brane coupling establish only a bounded quadratic effective action, not the complete five-dimensional Bianchi identities.
physics.equivalence_principle_proxy: The kernel is independent of tracer mass and composition; unchanged Halpha-to-stellar transfer tests but does not prove universality.
physics.lensing_boundary: No metric slip or null-geodesic prediction is derived in Item 36; later lensing promotion is mandatory.

candidate_generator.algorithm: PCG64 permutation of an exact mixed-radix grammar with 65536 raw cells in each of four screened extra-dimensional niches

niches.operator: positive finite Kaluza-Klein Yukawa tower with an explicit high-acceleration brane-localization shield
niches.equivalence: the unscreened short-distance KK tower is known; the shield is an added effective mechanism and any circular behavior may reduce to a radial running-force rewrite

niches.operator: positive warped-brane continuum correction with a bounded localization crossover
niches.equivalence: inspired by Randall-Sundrum localization but not a solved warped metric or exact continuum spectral density

niches.operator: short-distance four-dimensional to large-distance leakage crossover with a high-acceleration localization proxy
niches.equivalence: DGP-like architecture; enhancement signs or baryon-coupled variants are not the original DGP solution

niches.operator: positive scale-dependent spectral response whose infrared localization is covariantly keyed to response-blind baryonic source invariants
niches.equivalence: combines known dimensional flow and brane localization; historical novelty and non-equivalence to a running radial force are not established

equivalence_boundaries: Every circular snapshot correction is also compared with ordinary radial and acceleration running; a fit alone does not identify an extra dimension.
The high-acceleration shield is an explicit added localization mechanism and must not be attributed to unscreened ADD, RS, or DGP.
Brane-world Weyl-fluid rotation-curve fits are prior art; per-galaxy bulk constants are forbidden here.
A bounded Green-function proxy is not a solved five-dimensional metric, tensor perturbation spectrum, or lensing law.
Raw parameter cells are not independent laws; behavioral equivalence classes are counted separately and labels never prune.

evaluation.permutation_strategy: Freedman-Lane residual permutation around the ordinary radial OOF prediction within response-blind mass-by-size cells and annuli, with full candidate and baseline selection repeated
